snippet.title: Ball x Pit: Risen Ballbylon expansion reveal trailer - PC Gaming Show Tokyo Direct 2026
snippet.description:
20 new ball evolutions, eight new hunters, four new biomes, 20 new buildings, 46 new passives, and at least one guy who I'm reasonably certain is called "Potager". Sounds great to me.
